verdict.rationale: Retell documents a first-party Transfer Call tool that routes a live call to a human using cold (blind), warm, and agentic warm transfer modes, and function calling explicitly includes transferring calls. The pack does not explicitly document passing context, such as a summary, SIP headers, or metadata, to the human on transfer; the SIP-header evidence belongs to the separate End Call tool. Missing for 10: documented context or summary handoff to the receiving human, detailed transfer configuration docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along

citations.quote: Add the Transfer Call tool to a Retell single or multi-prompt agent to route calls to a human, with cold, warm, and agentic warm transfer modes.
Function calling lets Retell single or multi-prompt agents take real actions — transfer calls, end calls, book appointments, send SMS, and call external APIs.
